Auth.title: Sign in to BAKUMELO
Auth.subtitle: Sign in to claim {count, plural, one {your free credit} other {your # free credits}} and start composing.
Auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
Auth.confirmSent: Account created. Open the confirmation email we just sent you, then sign in.
Auth.senderNotice: The email is sent by Supabase, our authentication service: it will appear as "Supabase Auth" (noreply@mail.app.supabase.io) rather than BAKUMELO. Remember to check your spam folder.
Auth.resetSubtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.resetSent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has just been sent.

Studio.title: Music Creation Studio
Studio.subtitle: Lyrics are written automatically in the language of your prompt.
Studio.promptLabel: Describe your song idea (in the language you want)
Studio.promptPlaceholder: Ex: An upbeat Makossa love song celebrating a wedding...
Studio.waitBody: Processing usually takes one to three minutes, and five at most. Keep this page open: your track and its download button will appear here as soon as it is ready.
Studio.signedOut: Sign in to compose your track.
Studio.noCreditsBody: You need at least 1 credit to compose a track. Top up your account to continue.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.subtitle: Manage your tracks and your credits.
Dashboard.pendingHint: Generation in progress — the download button will appear here once the track is ready.
Dashboard.signedOut: Sign in to see your tracks.

Pricing.title: Top up your credits
Pricing.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# free trial credit is} other {# free trial credits are}} already available on your account after signing up.
Pricing.chargedInXaf: Charged in CFA francs (XAF). Other currencies are indicative.
Pricing.checkoutFailed: The payment could not be opened. Please try again shortly.
Pricing.issue_credited: Payment confirmed. Your credits are on your account.
Pricing.issue_already: This payment has already been credited to your account.
Pricing.issue_pending: Payment recorded. Your operator may take a moment to confirm; your credits will arrive automatically.
Pricing.issue_unverified: Confirmation in progress. If you were charged, your credits will be added automatically.
Pricing.issue_failed: The payment did not go through. You have not been charged.
Pricing.issue_unknown: Payment not found. Contact us if you were charged.
Pricing.awaitingConfirmation: Checking... this page will update on its own.

Admin.title: Administration Console
Admin.addCreditsPrompt: How many credits do you want to add?
Admin.stuckHint: These generations were never reconciled: the client closed the tab before completion. The credit was charged, but the track is often finished at Suno. "Recover" attaches it to the client account; "Refund" gives up and returns the credit.
Admin.refundConfirm: Give up on this generation and return the credit to the client?
Admin.stillPending: Suno has not finished this generation yet. Try again later.
Admin.noTaskRef: No task reference: only a refund is possible.
Admin.configHint: What the server actually sees. No secret value is shown — only whether a setting is present, and under which name. A variable added in Vercel takes effect only after a redeploy.
Admin.configMissingHelp: Set it in Vercel, then redeploy.
Admin.pendingPaymentsHint: Only the Notch Pay webhook credits an account, once settlement is final. If a webhook is lost, the payment stays here: "Check" asks Notch Pay again and credits if settlement is confirmed.
Admin.paymentStillPending: Notch Pay has not confirmed this settlement yet. Try again later.
Admin.paymentNotOpened: This payment was never opened at Notch Pay: nothing to check.
